title: A newborn Moro reflex flings the arms out, then pulls them in
summary: MedlinePlus says a newborn Moro, or startle, reflex extends the arms and then pulls them in, often with a brief cry.
body: MedlinePlus lists a Moro reflex, also called a startle reflex, among primitive reflexes in the newborn to 2 month span. A loud sound or a sudden movement often triggers it. The infant extends the arms, then bends and pulls them in toward the body, with a brief cry. This card is that pattern. How long the pattern stays is a different card. The description is one encyclopedia entry, not a test result for a named baby.
